 Medvedev makes a vital decision in the fight for the ATP Finals
 Diego Jiménez Rubio 
 - 17 Oct 2026 
 Go to comments seciton 
 Daniil Medvedev is determined to do everything possible to participate in the ATP Finals 2026 . This is evident from his good attitude and great tennis in Shanghai, but also from the fact that he has registered for the ATP 250 Almaty 2026 , a tournament that will take place next week. The Russian maintains his initial idea of seeking to defend the title from last year, although some believe he might reconsider this option if he reaches the final or wins the tournament held in China.
 In this regard, it is worth highlighting that the tournament held in Kazakhstan will feature big names, such as Alexander Bublik, Luciano Darderi, and Andrey Rublev . All of them, along with Medvedev, will be exempt from playing the first round. It will also be very interesting to follow the progress of a rising Stefanos Tsitsipas , eager to secure victories that will bring him closer to the top 30 and guarantee him a seeded position in Australia next year.
 There are fewer and fewer opportunities for mid-high ranked players to win titles, as ATP 250 events are declining. Therefore, this event in Almaty represents a great opportunity to see a fierce battle for a title that, in the case of Daniil Medvedev , would have the important consequence of giving him a vital boost in his quest to reach the ATP Finals 2026.
